  • ブランド: Shao Shao Kappa
  • 発売日: 2010-12-24
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 眠り姫の眠らぬ夜に…
  • 英語名: Nemuri Hime no Nemuranu Yoru ni…

あらすじ

In the year 1339, an 18-year-old princess goes to sleep, and she fails to awaken for over six months. Meanwhile, her father and brother are both killed at war, and the kingdom is on the verge of being conquered. The main character is a curse specialist called in to awaken the sleeping beauty by the end of the summer solstice festival, one week away. He decides to use whatever means possible to accomplish his goal…

  • 英語名: Yajuu Sentai Schwarkan

别名

  • Yajuu Sentai Shibarukan

あらすじ

In 2004 aliens are rescued on space station “Kibo”. They tell about crisis that approaches the Earth and die. Japan government together with UN create International Extraordinary Rescue Team to fight aliens invasion with the help of huge humanoid robots.

In 2009 runaways from inter-galactic prison showed up at the Earth to establish criminal foothold here.
